data.description: When a dark dancer is slain, its body combusts in a flash of bright white light, leaving its gear in a heap on the ground. All creatures within a 10-foot burst must succeed at a DC %1 Fortitude save or be dazzled for 1d6 rounds. Other dark folk within 20 feet must succeed at a DC %1 Will save or be shaken for 1 round.
data.name: Death Throes
